high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from ET Healthworld.com, which is part of The Economic Times. The article discusses the topic of vaccine recalls for COVID-19 vaccines. The header at the top of the page shows the website's logo and navigation options, including a menu icon on the left and a search icon on the right. The main content of the article is titled "3. Why are recalls not yet recommended?" and addresses the question of why vaccine recalls have not been recommended despite the potential waning of vaccine efficacy over time.
